notes_for_editor: Thin record: the only tower-specific source is the tnlandforms list row (name, coordinates, county, elevation, BLL and GFC numbers). No build date, design, staffing or fate found. The community's coordinates on Wikipedia (33.22222, -83.07361) differ from the tower's listed point by about 2 km, so the story does not tie the tower to the community's centre. The statewide 1980s context is general and does not say this tower was scrapped. The record's BLL-41092 is explained by the tnlandforms legend as a GFC-supplied coordinate set; the story does not claim more than that. Used 2 web searches. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the register's full 29-entry list was read and has no Devereux entry; the elevation unit is inferred from the table scale (Brasstown 4735), not labeled on the page.
